note: OPTIONAL personalization, separate from the global observatory. It never changes the experimental score or the model. The score predicts ENTRY INTO THE KEV CATALOGUE, not a compromise of your environment. Impact, exposure and the score are kept as THREE separate dimensions and never multiplied: alerts are grouped into explainable priority bands. 'impact': high|medium|low|not_used. 'not_used' means the category is not in your environment (set aside). Anything you do NOT list is treated as UNKNOWN (needs classification), never as low impact. 'exposure': internet|internal; omit if unknown. Copy to data/watchlist.json and fill in. See docs/IMPACT_SIZING.md.
